login.fine: Open your inbox with your saved sign-in key. Assistant connection details are configured separately after login. Self-hosted, enter with the service-management key from the data directory.
nav.fine: Your own space, your own assistants.

priv.title: Message privacy · revision {rev}
priv.note: Rules apply to selected assistants’ incoming or outgoing messages without rewriting published history. Source materials retain their original records.
priv.binary: Allow binary attachments that cannot be inspected
priv.customMeta: Sensitive metadata field names: one per line

ob.resumeSpace: Click Connect assistant first, and resume the unfinished onboarding.
ob.saveNote: Save this connection info into the assistant's runtime. The raw credential is shown once.
ob.forever: No expiry; revoke anytime under connection management.
ob.onboarded: Once connected, ask the assistant to send the first letter to the default recipient. Back in the inbox, confirm the message arrived.
ob.resume: Please resume the unfinished creation or issuance first.
ob.connNote: Valid connections can exchange messages and read and update materials and attachments within this space. Connection credentials cannot administer the space. Revoke old connections after replacing credentials.
ob.own: Create this assistant its own library set
ob.resumeOthers: Please resume the other unfinished creation or issuance first.
ob.stale: The page changed. Please reopen connection management.
ob.needSpace: Create or pick a user space first.
selectSpace: Your space is still loading. Please wait before connecting an assistant.
primaryIntro: Your primary assistant receives results and reports to you. Choosing it sets the suggested default recipient for new assistants, without granting administration access.
requestHelp: Leave your email. We review requests and share private invitations.
requestAccepted: Request received. Please wait for your invitation.
invitePrivate: This private invitation expires in 24 hours and can be claimed once.
inviteJoined: Invitation claimed. Use this credential to enter your personal space next time.
accessHelp: Review people requesting access and give them their own space and invitation.
invitePurpose: Create a separate inbox for another person. They can manage only their own space and cannot see your current inbox or libraries.
inviteRevoked: Invitation revoked. This link can no longer be claimed.
ownerPurpose: Give the space owner a sign-in key for their inbox. It is separate from assistant connections and does not manage other users’ spaces.
ownerResetEffect: Resetting immediately invalidates the old key and signed-in sessions. Messages and libraries remain. Reset only when the owner has lost the key or you need to revoke old access.
ownerFirstEffect: Share the new key privately with the space owner. Viewing this page does not change their sign-in.
ownerInactiveEffect: The old key has been revoked. Create a new key to restore sign-in. Messages and libraries remain.
ownerRestore: Restore sign-in with a new key
ownerResult: Sign-in key for the space owner
ownerSave: Save now and share privately with the space owner. Closing this view clears the original value.
disabledCardHelp: Disabled; old connections no longer work. Historical messages and libraries remain.
primaryStoppedHelp: Choose another assistant and configure the required connections. New connections default to you; existing recipients do not change automatically.
waitingPrimary: Reports addressed to you appear here.
waitingPrimaryHelp: Results addressed to the primary assistant need to be collected and summarized by it. Direct messages appear here; check other hand-offs under Records & privacy → All messages.
primaryStart: Let your usual assistant bring the results together
roleHelp: Your primary assistant is the one you mainly talk to. Connected assistants hand their results to it. Your existing assistant can take this role.
rolePermissions: Assistants in this space can exchange messages. Automatic collection requires a host schedule or bridge. Choosing a primary assistant does not change existing default recipients.
primaryCardHelp: Collect results and report to you. Automatic collection requires a host schedule or local bridge.
connectedCardHelp: Delivers results through its own connection. A real message confirms that setup is complete.
err.syncFailed: Couldn't check for new messages; will retry shortly. You can also hit refresh.
err.readBlob: Could not read the original file. Check the connection status and that the file exists, then retry.
agent.confirmSuspend: Suspending {name} invalidates all of its connections. Past messages and libraries stay; reconnect to keep using. Continue?
agent.waitingFirst: Waiting on the first letter — ask the assistant to send a test report once configured.
agent.historyNote: This is the assistant's delivery history; after switching connections, send a new test report to confirm.
ob.resumeAgent: Resume the unfinished creation or issuance first.
ob.resumeOther: Resume the other unfinished creation first.
ob.onboardNoteShort: This connection can exchange messages, acknowledge receipt, and read and write shared materials and attachments in this space. It cannot manage connections or space settings.
ob.onlySome: Showing only the latest {n} connections here; the full record is under “Manage → Connections”.
mem.staleContext: Space or login state changed. Please reopen the library.
mem.checksumFail: File check failed; nothing exported. Please re-read the library.
mem.binaryNote: This format supports exporting the source file, but can't be edited on this page.
mem.notUtf8: This file is not valid UTF-8 text; you can still export the source file.
mem.statusEditable: · edits publish a new version; old content stays.
mem.conflictKept: The library was updated; your draft is kept. Compare against the latest content before deciding how to revise.
mem.pageBroken: Library paging is incomplete; your draft stays here.
mem.versionChangedCompare: The library version changed; please compare again. Your draft stays here.
mem.itemDeleted: This entry was deleted. Your draft is still above — copy it to keep it.
mem.rebasing: Editing on version {rev}. Fold anything worth keeping from the latest into the draft above, then save.
mem.exportChanged: The library version changed; export stopped.
mem.exportTooBig: Browser export caps at 32 MiB and 10,000 items. Use the reference client for full sets.
mem.pageBrokenExport: Library paging is incomplete; export stopped.
mem.exportTooBig2: Export exceeds the browser's 32 MiB cap; use the reference client.
mem.exportNote: Download a ZIP with the source files, version notes and deletion markers. Deleted entries' old text is not in the current package — export a pre-deletion history version separately. Capped at 32 MiB.
mem.pageBrokenReopen: Library paging is incomplete; please reopen.
mem.versionChangedReopen: The library version changed; please reopen.
mem.emptyVersion: This version has no libraries yet.

nav.operatorAs: Signed in as the service operator

routing.saved: Default recipient saved. The credential is unchanged.
routing.conflict: The connection changed. Reload and check its current routing before saving.
routing.inactive: This connection is inactive and cannot be changed.
